scheme_name: Bihar State Alpsankhyak Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Bihar
Student must belong to a minority community
Admission will be based on merit list of examination marks
benefits_summary: Free residential education—including tuition, accommodation, food, clothing, medicine, books—and access to modern laboratories and vocational coaching for minority students from Class 9 to 12.
